What the record says

  • The Jets' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is home underdog (all time): 110-97-3 against the spread, a 53.1% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is home favorite (all time): 101-150-5, 40.2%.

  • All time they have covered 45.8% at home and 48.3% on the road, a 2.5 point edge on the road.
